snippet.title: Where the Heart Rests trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for my cute slice of life boys' love visual novel Where the Heart Rests. It's a wholesome story about a couple of men who take in a young boy after the death of his father.

There's a lot of sweet domestic moments and a slowburn BL romance with a lot of Yearning, I think it's sweet :)

You can find it on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099090/Where_the_Heart_Rests/
